title: Score Plot Cofiguration
bodyHtml:
Component props

<research-score-plot
    v-if="$parent.plotType == 'score_plot'"
    :plotData="$store.state.filteredData"
    :renderConfig="$parent.plotConfig"
    :dataComparisonConfig="$parent.dataComparisonConfig"
    :region="$store.state.searchingRegion"
    :searchParameters="$store.state.searchParameters"
></research-score-plot>

Example 1: http://localhost:8090/research.html?pageid=giant_region_view_local&ancestry=EU&phenotype=HEIGHT_GIANT&region=1:227615-267253

SearchParameters (generated by search UI)-key field for data comparison is "ancestry" in this example.
To find out how a value for searchParameters gets generated, look into ResearchPageFilters component.

{
    "phenotype": {
        "type": "list",
        "field": "phenotype",
        "search": [
            "HEIGHT_GIANT",
            "HEIGHT_GIANT"
        ]
    },
    "ancestry": {
        "type": "list",
        "field": "ancestry",
        "search": [
            "EU",
            "Mixed"
        ]
    },
    "region": {
        "type": "input",
        "field": "region",
        "search": [
            "1:227615-267253",
            "1:227615-267253"
        ]
    }
}

Plot Configuration

{
"xAxisField": "Locus", // Position field. It can be "chr:start-end" or "chr:position."
"yAxisField": "-log10(P-Value)", // Score field. 
"renderBy": "Variant ID", //The key to group dots by.
"yAxisLabel": "Score", // Label for y axis.
"xAxisLabel": "Position", // Label for x axis.
"hoverContent": ["Ref/Alt","P-Value"], // Data to show on hovering/clicking a dot.
"height": 200, // Height of the plot. Default is 300px.
"scoreColumnTableHeader":"-log10(P-Value)", //When the score gets recalculated, it updates data in the table. When value for 'reCalculateScore' is 'false,' it isn't used.
"scoreBy":[{"field":"-log10(P-Value)","type": "rawValue"}], //It builds re-calculate score by UI based on this. This case re-calculation is off. You won't actually need it.
"reCalculateScore":false, 
"inputType":"dynamic", // InputType can be 'dynamic' or 'static.' If it is 'dynamic,' codes will look for a value for "dynamicParameter" parameter. If static, it will look for a value for 'region' parameter.
"dynamicParameter":"region", //only when inputType is dynamic
"genesTrack":{}, //If "genesTrack" is undefined, genes track won't be rendered. I left it as an object for future use.
"region":"4:1795034-1810599"//only when inputType is static
  }

dataComparisonFormat

Data search UI in the example page is rendered by this config. However, what matters for Score Plot is "fieldsToCompare." When hover-on-dot content gets gathered, the code checks if displaying data fields are in the array. If they are, the code loops through the items in value objects of the fields. 

{
"keyField":"Variant ID",
"fieldsGroupDataKey":"ancestry",
"fieldsToCompare":["Ancestry","-log10(P-Value)","P-Value","Beta","Odds Ratio","EAF","MAF","Standard Error","Z Score"]
}

Example 2: http://localhost:8090/research.html?pageid=prioritized_genes_giant_height_local

Data

In this example, dataComparison configuration is null. Data gets wrapped in an array.

[
    {
        "Ensembl ID": "ENSG00000228463",
        "HGNC": "-",
        "Region": "1:227615-267253",
        "DEPICT": "no",
        "MAGMA": "no",
        "PoPS": "no",
        "OMIM": "no",
        "Gene nearest COJO": "no",
        "eQTL COJO": "no",
        "Functional COJO": "no",
        "Score": 0
    },
]

Plot configuration

{
            "xAxisField": "Region",
            "yAxisField": "Score",
            "renderBy": "Ensembl ID",
            "yAxisLabel": "Score",
            "xAxisLabel": "Chromosome",
            "hoverContent": ["HGNC","Region"],
            "height": 300,
            "scoreColumnTableHeader":"Score",
            "scoreBy":[ //Currently re calculation only works for "boolean" values. 
                        {"field":"DEPICT","type": "boolean", "valueToScore": { "yes": 1, "no": 0},"weight":1}, 
                        {"field":"MAGMA","type": "boolean", "valueToScore": { "yes": 1, "no": 0},"weight":1},
                        {"field":"PoPS","type": "boolean", "valueToScore": { "yes": 1, "no": 0},"weight":1},
                        {"field":"OMIM","type": "boolean", "valueToScore": { "yes": 1, "no": 0},"weight":1},
                        {"field":"Gene nearest COJO","type": "boolean", "valueToScore": { "yes": 1, "no": 0},"weight":1},
                        {"field":"eQTL COJO","type": "boolean", "valueToScore": { "yes": 1, "no": 0},"weight":1},
                        {"field":"Functional COJO","type": "boolean", "valueToScore": { "yes": 1, "no": 0},"weight":1}
            ],
"reCalculateScore":true //Since it's true, re-calculation UI gets rendered.
        }
